answer: Every identity posts the cost of replicating its work. Funds sit in escrow until finality. Idle identities bleed standing each epoch. The edge case is timing: a farm answering at the same second across accounts gets flagged before escrow releases. Timber-grade bonds do not help there. One crystal-clear pattern, three accounts, one 5 second window, and the whole terrace of identities reads as a single operator.
